verdict.rationale: Navan advertises "unlimited policy and approval workflows", and its MCP docs say transactions are automatically flagged or routed for approval under policy rules. The API also offers webhooks, so external systems can react to Navan events. However, there is no documented general-purpose rule builder where users define their own triggers and actions; event-driven automation beyond policy and approval routing would need webhooks plus external tooling. Missing for 10: documented user-defined trigger/action rule engine, list of supported event types, custom action types beyond approvals, independent or hands-on corroboration.
